title: Idolatry of Impaler Nix
description: Idolatry of Impaler Nix — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chuck McBarris

Quest Type: Search

Quest Description: Find and destroy Impaler Nix in Cleaveland.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold 1 KC

Return to: Chuck McBarris

Repeatable: No

Tip: Impaler Nix is a Shadow Fade General Hero, surrounded by support troops. He is difficult but no more than any Hero. Find him, kill him, collect.
